description.content: Lays out its children side by side (horizontally) or stacked (vertically), with resizable separators between them.
Uniquely identifies the split within the workspace.
Optional in the defaultModel prop and the setModel method; splits without ids are assigned ids based on their position (e.g. "split-root").
Children are laid out side by side ("horizontal") or stacked ("vertical").
Size of the split within its parent split.

Interpretation rules:

  • Numbers are percentages of the parent split (e.g. size: 25 is 25 percent)
  • Strings may specify other units (e.g. size: "250px"); strings without units are percentages
  • Siblings without a size share the remaining space evenly
String sizes are only initial sizes: they're converted to percentages when the user resizes the split, and (like percentages) they scale with the workspace when it's resized.
Tabsets and nested splits, in the order they are shown.
